rachats.citation: Zurich signed an acquisition agreement with Texas-based Special Insurance Services, November 2021.
Zurich and Farmers acquire MetLife's Property and Casualty segment for a total purchase price of $3.6 billion, December 2020.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
